profile.headline: Manager Software Engineer at TRUNO, Retail Technology Solutions
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack backend focused software engineer with 8+ years of experience architecting, building, and scaling production applications, APIs, microservices, and high volume distributed systems. Hands on with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS, Node.js, and modern cloud infrastructure, with additional frontend experience using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Angular. I’m experienced owning technical architecture and delivery from system design through deployment and production.

At Truno, I’ve led development on microservices and point-of-sale systems, integrated Apache Kafka for high-volume data pipelines, and optimized CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins.

I love solving hard problems with clean code and collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life.

Let’s connect if you’re building something big.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Lead technical architecture, system design, and engineering delivery across high volume production
systems while remaining hands on with development, code reviews, debugging, and production
support.
• Architect, own, and maintain the production infrastructure end to end, with direct responsibility for
CI/CD, deployments, reliability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing operations.
• Design and implement backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and production solutions using
Java, Springboot, Kafka, AWS, and modern cloud infrastructure.
• Design and implement frontend applications using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Angular
• Manage and mentor software engineers, including workload prioritization, technical guidance,
performance feedback, career development, and day to day team leadership.
positions.insights: Cloud Infrastructure, Technical Leadership and +7 skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led architecture and development of APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Grails, and
Angular, improving application scalability and performance.
• Designed and implemented Apache Kafka based data processing supporting millions of transactions
daily across high volume production systems.
• Owned technical delivery across multiple projects, from architecture and implementation through
deployment and production support.
• Implemented and maintained DevOps solutions using Grafana, Jenkins, Prometheus, Docker, HAProxy,
and load balancers to improve CI/CD and system performance.
• Conducted code reviews and provided technical mentorship to engineers, promoting code quality and
engineering best practices.

projects.title: co-founder dibbs technologies
projects.description:
Built a real-time availability monitoring platform for travel agents that continuously tracks resort
and dining availability and automatically sends SMS and email alerts when openings are detected;
currently deployed for exclusive use by Travelmation, with expansion planned.
• Independently architected and developed the full-stack production application using React, Node.js,
and PostgreSQL, owning the system from architecture through production.
• Designed and deployed a containerized AWS environment and integrated AWS SES, Twilio, and Stripe to
support communications and platform functionality.

projects.title: Co-founder linkley
projects.description:
Architected functionality that converts standard URLs from platforms such as Amazon, Target, Walmart,
Venmo, and others into deep links, routing users directly to the appropriate app or web destination.
• Independently architected and developed the full-stack production application using Next.js and
PostgreSQL, owning the platform from system design through production.
• Designed and deployed a containerized AWS production environment and own ongoing infrastructure,
deployment, reliability, maintenance, and production operations.
